position: 0
item_id: GRADE_EDGE
benchmark: GRADE
axis: supporting-fact edge set
construction_description: Shortest directed acyclic paths of length 2 to 5 are enumerated within a knowledge graph; the unique answer is the terminal node of the path, and all supporting facts are contained in the edge set of the graph. A semantic-clustering augmentation adds links beyond the original graph.
verbatim_excerpt_from_benchmark_paper: "We first enumerated all shortest directed acyclic paths of length 2 to 5 within the knowledge graph"; "all supporting facts are contained in the edge set P"

Stage 2, sheet PartA, one row:

position: 0
item_id: GRADE_PASSAGE
benchmark: GRADE
axis: retrieval chunk
construction_description: Source articles are split into text chunks and embedded; supporting evidence traces back to original source documents. The chunks serving as gold for a question are selected by guidance from the question's path and answer, while the chunk text itself is source text.
verbatim_excerpt_from_benchmark_paper: "we split each article into chunks ... and embedded them"; "supporting evidence traces back to original source documents"

Fill source_K_A_T, base_bin_0_4, corrections, final_bin_0_4, key_phrase, and confidence_1_3 for this row. End your reply with the RATING line.

position: 0
item_id: GRB_ANSWER
benchmark: GraphRAG-Bench
axis: answer
construction_description: Questions are generated by aligning their cognitive demands with the structural properties of the underlying evidence subgraph; the answer is anchored to the mined subgraph with its surface present in text, and human checking is applied.
verbatim_excerpt_from_benchmark_paper: "Questions are generated by aligning their cognitive demands with the structural properties of the underlying evidence"

Fill source_K_A_T, base_bin_0_4, corrections, final_bin_0_4, key_phrase, and confidence_1_3 for this row. End your reply with the RATING line.

Stage 2, sheet PartA, one row:

position: 0
item_id: GRB_SUBGRAPH
benchmark: GraphRAG-Bench
axis: evidence subgraph
construction_description: Logic Mining transforms raw text into structured domain ontologies; evidence is isolated into localized subgraphs mined from the corpus, and questions are generated according to the complexity of the underlying evidence, combined with human checking for final confirmation.
verbatim_excerpt_from_benchmark_paper: "Logic Mining ... transform raw text into structured domain ontologies"; "isolating evidence into localized subgraphs ... and multi-hop chains"; "if no evidence triple can be inferred from the corpus, the question is discarded ... combined with human checking for final confirmation"

Fill source_K_A_T, base_bin_0_4, corrections, final_bin_0_4, key_phrase, and confidence_1_3 for this row. End your reply with the RATING line.

item_id: HOTPOT_ANSWER
benchmark: HotpotQA
axis: answer
construction_description: The answer is a span written by the crowd worker over the Wikipedia paragraph text; no knowledge graph is involved in construction.
verbatim_excerpt_from_benchmark_paper:

Stage 2, sheet PartA, one row:

position: 0
item_id: HOTPOT_SENTENCE
benchmark: HotpotQA
axis: supporting sentence
construction_description: Crowd workers write questions over pairs of linked Wikipedia paragraphs and explicitly mark the sentence-level supporting facts they used to answer; the construction explicitly rejects a knowledge graph and focuses on text-based question answering.
verbatim_excerpt_from_benchmark_paper: "we also ask the crowd workers to provide the supporting facts they use to answer"; "we focus on text-based question answering"

Fill source_K_A_T, base_bin_0_4, corrections, final_bin_0_4, key_phrase, and confidence_1_3 for this row. End your reply with the RATING line.

Stage 2, sheet PartA, one row:

position: 0
item_id: METAQA_ANSWER
benchmark: MetaQA
axis: answer
construction_description: All questions are generated from a movie knowledge base using question templates; the answer is the tail entity reached by traversing the knowledge-graph reasoning path.
verbatim_excerpt_from_benchmark_paper: "each edge from E(G) is a triplet (a_i^1, r_i, a_i^2), representing a directed relation"; "we design 21 question types ... 10 question templates and uniformly randomly sample"

Fill source_K_A_T, base_bin_0_4, corrections, final_bin_0_4, key_phrase, and confidence_1_3 for this row. End your reply with the RATING line.

Stage 2, sheet PartA, one row:

position: 0
item_id: METAQA_PATH
benchmark: MetaQA
axis: reasoning path
construction_description: The gold reasoning path is a sequence of knowledge-graph triples; the 2-hop and 3-hop subsets are generated from the same knowledge base by relation-chain traversal.
verbatim_excerpt_from_benchmark_paper: "The 2-hop and 3-hop datasets are generated from the same knowledge base"

Fill source_K_A_T, base_bin_0_4, corrections, final_bin_0_4, key_phrase, and confidence_1_3 for this row. End your reply with the RATING line.

Stage 2, sheet PartA, one row:

position: 0
item_id: MHRAG_ANSWER
benchmark: MultiHop-RAG
axis: answer
construction_description: Claims are paraphrased from article sentences by GPT-4, which then composes a query whose answer is grounded in the source claims; a subset is manually reviewed. No knowledge graph is used.
verbatim_excerpt_from_benchmark_paper: "we feed the claim set to GPT-4 and prompt it ... to generate a query"; "we manually review a subset sample"

Fill source_K_A_T, base_bin_0_4, corrections, final_bin_0_4, key_phrase, and confidence_1_3 for this row. End your reply with the RATING line.

Stage 2, sheet PartA, one row:

position: 0
item_id: MHRAG_EVIDENCE
benchmark: MultiHop-RAG
axis: supporting evidence
construction_description: Factual sentences are extracted from news articles by a trained language model; the gold evidence is these source-text sentences paired with article metadata. No knowledge graph is used.
verbatim_excerpt_from_benchmark_paper: "For each article, we extract factual or opinion sentences using a trained language model"

Fill source_K_A_T, base_bin_0_4, corrections, final_bin_0_4, key_phrase, and confidence_1_3 for this row. End your reply with the RATING line.

item_id: MUSIQUE_ANSWER
benchmark: MuSiQue
axis: answer
construction_description: The answer is the human-annotated answer of the composed question's final hop, inherited from the source single-hop datasets; a disconnection filter rejects questions answerable without all hops. No knowledge graph is used.
verbatim_excerpt_from_benchmark_paper:

Stage 2, sheet PartA, one row:

position: 0
item_id: MUSIQUE_PASSAGE
benchmark: MuSiQue
axis: supporting passage
construction_description: Composed bottom-up from human-annotated single-hop questions drawn from five English Wikipedia-based reading-comprehension datasets; the supporting paragraph for each hop is the annotated paragraph carried over from the source dataset. No knowledge graph is used; a disconnection filter and an anti-leakage split are applied.
verbatim_excerpt_from_benchmark_paper: "We begin with a large set of RC single-hop questions from 5 English Wikipedia-based datasets ... (qi, pi, ai)"

Fill source_K_A_T, base_bin_0_4, corrections, final_bin_0_4, key_phrase, and confidence_1_3 for this row. End your reply with the RATING line.

position: 0
item_id: NQ_ANSWER
benchmark: Natural Questions
axis: short answer
construction_description: The short answer is one or more entities, or a boolean, selected by a human annotator as a span on the Wikipedia page.
verbatim_excerpt_from_benchmark_paper: "the short answer is one or more entities that give a short answer to the question, or a boolean"

Fill source_K_A_T, base_bin_0_4, corrections, final_bin_0_4, key_phrase, and confidence_1_3 for this row. End your reply with the RATING line.

Stage 2, sheet PartA, one row:

position: 0
item_id: NQ_PASSAGE
benchmark: Natural Questions
axis: long-answer passage
construction_description: Annotators identify the long answer by selecting the smallest HTML bounding box that contains all information required to answer the question, on a Wikipedia page provided from top search results.
verbatim_excerpt_from_benchmark_paper: "Annotators identify long answers by selecting the smallest HTML bounding box that contains all information required to answer the question"

Fill source_K_A_T, base_bin_0_4, corrections, final_bin_0_4, key_phrase, and confidence_1_3 for this row. End your reply with the RATING line.

position: 0
item_id: OURSLOW_ANSWER
benchmark: Anchor benchmark L
axis: answer
construction_description: The answer must be a short span quoted verbatim from the passage, enforced by a deterministic gate; the knowledge graph is never provided in the prompt, with a static import guard.
verbatim_excerpt_from_benchmark_paper: code: "the answer must be a short span quoted verbatim from the passage"

Fill source_K_A_T, base_bin_0_4, corrections, final_bin_0_4, key_phrase, and confidence_1_3 for this row. End your reply with the RATING line.

Stage 2, sheet PartA, one row:

position: 0
item_id: OURSLOW_PASSAGE
benchmark: Anchor benchmark L
axis: supporting passage
construction_description: A generator model receives only raw corpus passage text; the evidence span is an exact substring of the passage. The knowledge graph is never provided in the prompt, and a static import guard forbids the generation pipeline from importing any knowledge-graph code.
verbatim_excerpt_from_benchmark_paper: docstring: "answer is derived ONLY from passage text; the KG is NEVER provided in the prompt"

Fill source_K_A_T, base_bin_0_4, corrections, final_bin_0_4, key_phrase, and confidence_1_3 for this row. End your reply with the RATING line.

Stage 2, sheet PartA, one row:

position: 0
item_id: OURSUP_ANSWER
benchmark: Anchor benchmark U
axis: answer
construction_description: The answer text is built by filling a textual template with a knowledge-graph edge's relation phrase and its context field; no language model is involved.
verbatim_excerpt_from_benchmark_paper: code: build_answer fills a template with the KG edge's relation_type and context

Fill source_K_A_T, base_bin_0_4, corrections, final_bin_0_4, key_phrase, and confidence_1_3 for this row. End your reply with the RATING line.

Stage 2, sheet PartA, one row:

position: 0
item_id: OURSUP_EDGE
benchmark: Anchor benchmark U
axis: gold edge
construction_description: The canonical gold edge identifier is written directly from the knowledge-graph triple in the form source--relation-->target; overlap with the knowledge graph is total by construction.
verbatim_excerpt_from_benchmark_paper: code: canonical_edge_ids = ["{src}--{rel}-->{tgt}"]; docstring: "edge overlap is 100%. No LLM is required for these fields"

Fill source_K_A_T, base_bin_0_4, corrections, final_bin_0_4, key_phrase, and confidence_1_3 for this row. End your reply with the RATING line.

Stage 2, sheet PartA, one row:

position: 0
item_id: OURSUP_ENTITY
benchmark: Anchor benchmark U
axis: gold entity
construction_description: The expected gold entities are the two endpoint node identifiers of a knowledge-graph edge, copied directly from the evaluation knowledge graph by code.
verbatim_excerpt_from_benchmark_paper: code: "expected_entities": [head.node_id, tail.node_id]

Fill source_K_A_T, base_bin_0_4, corrections, final_bin_0_4, key_phrase, and confidence_1_3 for this row. End your reply with the RATING line.

Stage 2, sheet PartA, one row:

position: 0
item_id: OURSUP_PATH
benchmark: Anchor benchmark U
axis: gold path
construction_description: The gold path is the pair of endpoint node identifiers of the knowledge-graph edge, copied from the evaluation knowledge graph.
verbatim_excerpt_from_benchmark_paper: code: "gold_paths": [[head.node_id, tail.node_id]]

Fill source_K_A_T, base_bin_0_4, corrections, final_bin_0_4, key_phrase, and confidence_1_3 for this row. End your reply with the RATING line.

Stage 2, sheet PartA, one row:

position: 0
item_id: STARK_ANSWERENTITY
benchmark: STaRK
axis: answer entity
construction_description: A relation template is sampled and instantiated into a relational requirement over the knowledge base; the gold answer is a candidate node satisfying that requirement. Three models verify candidates, and only candidates passing all three enter the final ground-truth answer set.
verbatim_excerpt_from_benchmark_paper: "we sample a relation template ... select one of the candidate nodes that satisfies the relational requirement, which is referred to as the gold answer"; "we employ three Claude models. Only candidates that pass the verification across all models are included in the final ground truth answer set"

Fill source_K_A_T, base_bin_0_4, corrections, final_bin_0_4, key_phrase, and confidence_1_3 for this row. End your reply with the RATING line.

Stage 2, sheet PartA, one row:

position: 0
item_id: STARK_TEXTUAL
benchmark: STaRK
axis: textual property
construction_description: Query requirements include textual properties extracted from the gold node's free text; this axis is knowledge-base node free-text rather than the relational structure, fused into the query by a language model.
verbatim_excerpt_from_benchmark_paper: "We extract textual properties that align with the interests" (from the gold node's free text)

Fill source_K_A_T, base_bin_0_4, corrections, final_bin_0_4, key_phrase, and confidence_1_3 for this row. End your reply with the RATING line.

Stage 2, sheet PartA, one row:

position: 0
item_id: TRIVIA_ANSWER
benchmark: TriviaQA
axis: answer
construction_description: Question-answer pairs are authored independently by trivia enthusiasts, before and independently of evidence gathering.
verbatim_excerpt_from_benchmark_paper: "95K question-answer pairs authored by trivia enthusiasts and independently gathered evidence documents"

Fill source_K_A_T, base_bin_0_4, corrections, final_bin_0_4, key_phrase, and confidence_1_3 for this row. End your reply with the RATING line.

Stage 2, sheet PartA, one row:

position: 0
item_id: TRIVIA_EVIDENCE
benchmark: TriviaQA
axis: evidence document
construction_description: Evidence documents are gathered after the fact and retained for a question when they contain the answer string; the construction states that the presence of the answer string in an evidence document implies that the document answers the question.
verbatim_excerpt_from_benchmark_paper: "the presence of the answer string in an evidence document implies that the document does answer the question"

Fill source_K_A_T, base_bin_0_4, corrections, final_bin_0_4, key_phrase, and confidence_1_3 for this row. End your reply with the RATING line.

Stage 2, sheet PartA, one row:

position: 0
item_id: TWOWIKI_ANSWER
benchmark: 2WikiMultiHop
axis: answer
construction_description: Questions are created from predefined templates by replacing template tokens with entity labels, using logical-rule information in the knowledge graph; the answer is the object entity of the Wikidata logical rule.
verbatim_excerpt_from_benchmark_paper: "utilizing the logical rule information in the knowledge graph ... we can create more natural questions"

Fill source_K_A_T, base_bin_0_4, corrections, final_bin_0_4, key_phrase, and confidence_1_3 for this row. End your reply with the RATING line.

Stage 2, sheet PartA, one row:

position: 0
item_id: TWOWIKI_EDGE
benchmark: 2WikiMultiHop
axis: evidence triple
construction_description: Evidence is a set of triples, each a structured datum of subject entity, property, and object entity, obtained from the Wikidata.
verbatim_excerpt_from_benchmark_paper: "Evidence information in our dataset is a set of triples, where each triple is a structured data (subject entity, property, object entity) obtained from the Wikidata"

Fill source_K_A_T, base_bin_0_4, corrections, final_bin_0_4, key_phrase, and confidence_1_3 for this row. End your reply with the RATING line.

Stage 2, sheet PartA, one row:

position: 0
item_id: TWOWIKI_SENTENCE
benchmark: 2WikiMultiHop
axis: supporting sentence
construction_description: Sentence-level supporting facts are sentence indices found by a heuristic that checks whether the Wikidata object value appears in the Wikipedia article for the entity; the knowledge-graph value is projected onto text, while the sentence surface itself is Wikipedia text.
verbatim_excerpt_from_benchmark_paper: "SF is a set of sentence indices where the values o1 and o2 are extracted"

Fill source_K_A_T, base_bin_0_4, corrections, final_bin_0_4, key_phrase, and confidence_1_3 for this row. End your reply with the RATING line.

benchmark: WebQSP

construction_description: SPARQL queries with standard Freebase entity identifiers are provided and are directly executable on Freebase; the gold answers are the Freebase entities returned by executing the parse.
verbatim_excerpt_from_benchmark_paper: "... provides the semantic parses in SPARQL with standard Freebase entity identifiers, which are directly executable on Freebase"

benchmark: WebQSP
axis: inferential chain
construction_description: The core component is the inferential chain representing the relation between the topic entity and the answer in Freebase; the gold semantic parse encodes this chain with Freebase identifiers.
verbatim_excerpt_from_benchmark_paper: "the core component is to represent the relation between the entity and the answer, referred as the inferential chain"
